title: finding(plugin-list): `ObjectGallery`'s enriched-field copy carries `precision` but never `scale`, so a gallery percent field declaring `scale` renders unpadded — pre-existing since the number arm moved, widened by one type
body:
Surfaced by the `os-dev` delivering objectui#9295's patch round (PR objectui#9566), and **filed by the dispatching `domain:ui` seat** (`session_01KSd9P5u2Mf4p8g4n4SD4Fx`, `os-justin`). ⛔ Not graded and ⛔ not routed by me.

## The fact — re-derived at source by this seat on `origin/main`

`packages/plugin-list/src/ObjectGallery.tsx:363-368`, the enriched-field builder:

```ts
if (def.type) enriched.type = def.type;
if (def.label) enriched.label = def.label;
if (def.options) enriched.options = def.options;
if (def.currency) enriched.currency = def.currency;
if (def.precision !== undefined) enriched.precision = def.precision;
if (def.format) enriched.format = def.format;
```

**`scale` is not copied.** The enriched field then routes through `resolveCellRendererType` / `getCellRenderer` to the shared cell renderers — and the file's own docblock at `:297` states the intent: the shared pipeline *"used by Detail/Grid/Related"* should receive *"the same context"*.

⇒ a gallery card's **percent** field declaring `scale: 2` renders `25%` instead of `25.00%`, because the member the renderer now reads never reaches it.

## ⚠️ A grep trap, recorded so the next reader is not misled

`git grep -c scale` on this file returns **4**, which reads like "scale is handled here." **It is not.** All four are Tailwind transform classes and one prose word:

```
:139  group-hover:scale-[1.08]
:148  group-hover:scale-[1.04]
:170  prose — "at icon scale"
:194  group-hover:scale-110
```

⇒ the field member `scale` appears **zero** times. Lit control in the same pass: `precision` returns **3** in the same file, so the instrument fires.

## ⭐ PRE-EXISTING, and ⛔ NOT a regression introduced by objectui#9295

Stated precisely, because the framing decides how it is graded:

- `NumberCellRenderer` has read `scale` since **objectui#2134**, so a gallery **number** field declaring `scale` is **already** unpadded today, before any of this round's work.
- objectui#9295 moved the percent surfaces onto `scale` as well, which **widens the blast radius by one field type** and makes this file's own *"same context"* claim false for one more type.

⇒ the defect is the **missing copy**, not the percent change. Repairing it at the producer (copy `scale` alongside `precision`) fixes both types at once.

## ⚠️ Worth measuring before designing the fix

Whether any other member the shared renderers now consume is likewise missing from this copy list — the list is hand-maintained and enumerates six members by name, so the same class of omission can recur silently. A copy that derives from the renderer's declared inputs rather than a hand list would close the class; a one-member patch closes only this instance.

## Dedup words

`ObjectGallery buildEnrichedField` · `enriched.precision` · `gallery card cell renderer scale` · `plugin-list enriched field meta` · `gallery percent scale`

⛔ Not deduped by me (filer attaches the words, triage runs them); dedup must include CLOSED cards, and any zero needs a lit control.
